title: Detectors for Safe and Reliable LLMs: Implementations, Uses, and Limitations
reasoning: The paper features a component dedicated to 'Contextual and Normative Detectors' which evaluate LLM outputs against social and moral norms (referencing Moral Foundations Theory, such as the loyalty-betrayal axis). It also provides an in-depth analysis of the inherent ethical and sociological challenges in defining and labeling human attributes like 'stigma' and 'harm'.
